note: Authored observation fixtures for PCHPP §4-style dual-layer readouts. Synthetic payloads — not live LLM bills.

cases.target: Optimizing token routing across a multi-agent coding station.

shadow.summary: Multi-agent coding stations frequently suffer from high latency and context exhaustion due to redundant token passing between orchestrators and worker sub-agents. Current solutions rely on arbitrary context truncation or expensive API caching layer strategies.
shadow.surface_state: Observable symptom: slow turns and truncated worker context.

code.master_instruction_vector: Governing state is an unbalanced loop where sub-agents re-evaluate global system prompts on every execution turn rather than receiving delta updates.
code.entropic_boundary: Failure occurs at the inter-agent boundary due to payload duplication and unstructured JSON state transfers that cause context drift after recursive turns.
code.zero_entropy_path: Use E_F lock-and-key delta payloads so workers receive only differential state.

cases.target: Diagnosing a flat context dump that mixes policy, logs, and user ask.

shadow.summary: The model returns a long blended answer that restates the paste pile. Operators see verbosity and occasional contradictions between policy snippets and the live ask.

code.master_instruction_vector: Context window is treated as a flat buffer; no phase-gate separates policy constraints from ephemeral logs.
code.entropic_boundary: Policy, logs, and ask occupy one band so retrieval noise raises effective ΔS and drifts the governing constraint.
code.zero_entropy_path: Apply PCHPP dual-layer stain: Shadow summary then Code vector with explicit constraint lock.

cases.target: Observing a bio-geometric metaphor stack that only reports phenotypes.

shadow.summary: Phenotype tables list visible traits and local environment effects. Readers mistake the table for the governing grammar of the nest.
shadow.surface_state: Observable: trait list without operator map.

code.master_instruction_vector: Phenotypes are the gravity shadow of a phase-locked genomic/operator template, not the template itself.
code.entropic_boundary: Diagnostic failure when trait catalogs are optimized without naming the master instruction vector.
code.zero_entropy_path: Stain with E_F contrast: report Shadow traits then Code operator constraints separately.
